name: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotion_conversion/emotion_models/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.train_duration_predictor: train a CnnPredictor model to predict token durations from clustered speech data using TSV and KM files
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.load_checkpoint: load a saved CnnPredictor checkpoint from a file path and return the model in eval mode
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.save_checkpoint: save a CnnPredictor model state dict with padding token and model class config to a file path
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.inflate_input: predict durations for a batch of token sequences and inflate each token by its predicted duration count
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.collate_batch: collate a batch of token sequences and duration labels into padded tensors with attention masks

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.train_CnnPredictor: train a CNN pitch predictor model for F0 prediction from phoneme tokens using hydra config
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.load_ckpt_CnnPredictor: load a saved CnnPredictor checkpoint from a file path and restore model state and F0 stats
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.inference_CnnPredictor: run inference with CnnPredictor to predict F0 values from token sequences with speaker and style embeddings
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.quantize_f0: compute adaptive F0 quantization bins from speaker statistics using histogram-based percentile binning
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.freq2bin_bin2freq: convert F0 frequency values to bin indices and back using bucketize or one-hot probability distributions

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.create_Stat_class: create a Stat object to track running mean and std of torch tensor values
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.update_Stat_with_tensor: update a Stat object with new torch tensor data to accumulate statistics
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.create_F0Stat_class: create an F0Stat object to track F0 statistics filtering out unvoiced zero frames
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.create_Accuracy_class: create an Accuracy object to track prediction accuracy with a tolerance threshold
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/emotio.compute_Accuracy_score: compute the accuracy score from an Accuracy object using a tolerance value
